theme_assessments.assessment: The portfolio is heavily exposed to the AI capex supercycle, betting that hyperscaler spending will continue to accelerate despite emerging constraints like power shortages and local opposition. The thesis assumes that the $700B-$1T capex trajectory will sustain through 2026-2027.
theme_assessments.implication: If AI capex slows due to grid constraints or cost overruns, NVDA, MSFT, and ASML could face significant downside pressure. The portfolio lacks direct exposure to grid infrastructure or energy constraints.
